title: Paired seat-average actor-return pilot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: For the same fixed deal and opponent, averaging the raw hero payoff across a source hand and its hole-card-swapped opposite-seat mirror will cancel seat/card variance and provide a lower-variance actor advantage, while retaining raw realized rewards for critic learning and league accounting.
material_change: Add an opt-in paired-seat actor reward contract to the single-rollout AlphaHoldem trainer. Mirror every fixed-stream deal against the same opponent, match source player p to mirror player 1-p, keep transition reward t[6] raw for critic/value targets, append only a terminal actor reward override equal to the two-seat mean, and train the same frozen-trunk all-policy-head configuration as adaptive-league-all-heads-pilot-20260830.
baseline: adaptive-league-all-heads-pilot-20260830 untouched fresh-only control; mirrored-selfplay-deals-pilot-20260830 mirrored only self-play deals but did not pair-center actor advantages.

notes: Smoke is fail-closed: source/replay counts and same-opponent identity must pair exactly; raw critic reward must remain unchanged; actor override must appear only on terminal rows; actor terminal variance must decline; fixed-pool/session audit, KL, ratios, and action mix must remain healthy. Production is forbidden until all gates pass.

First end-to-end smoke was safely interrupted at 0 accounted hands after worker failures exposed that a trainable seat may have no policy decision; its initialized manifest and errors are preserved under smoke/. Recovery changed pairing to use explicit full per-player terminal rewards while preserving raw transition rewards.

Smoke2 completed 536 hands and validated integration, but actor/raw variance statistics were not yet persisted. It is preserved unchanged; train_v5.py was then patched to persist the already-computed statistics in score, JSONL, and manifest evidence.

Smoke3 completed 530 hands: 275 matched source/mirror pairs, 661 terminal-only actor overrides, raw terminal variance 0.0190604134880725, actor terminal variance 0.0122926780236482, ratio 0.644932389915916. Fixed-pool/session audit PASS; production gate passed.

Production launched only after smoke3 variance and session gates passed. Configuration matches the untouched adaptive-league all-policy-head control except every fixed-stream deal is mirrored against the same opponent and only actor terminal rewards are pair-averaged.

Production completed without interruption: 64 iterations and 263,479 actual environment hands. Fixed-pool audit and paired-session audit both PASS; 158,350 balanced pairs, 321,784 terminal-only actor overrides, every batch variance ratio below one.

The initial code snapshot is retained unchanged. production_code/ captures the final trainer code actually used after the smoke fixes; the trainer code was unchanged between smoke3, production, and this capture. Its patch SHA256 is 40870a5a104651b94ab4cc13e726b53ef16f7b66e8c259219cfb863758ccdccd.
Corrected two manually transcribed smoke command run-dir fields to the actual smoke/ and smoke2/ paths; raw manifests and checkpoint evidence were not changed.
All four frozen curves completed with valid OOD/mirror signals. No control artifacts or training artifacts were modified during evaluation.

Accounting correction from physical-hand-accounting-repair-20260830: legacy total_hands counts only transition-bearing hands. Production marker count remains 263479 in immutable checkpoints, while 158350 balanced emitted pairs prove at least 316700 physical hands. Completed smokes each emitted 275 pairs, so new_training_hands is corrected to the physical lower bound 317800, not an exact total; missing historical worker tails and failed pre-update smoke work are not invented. Prior actual-hand labels in notes/audit v1 refer to the legacy marker counter and are superseded by the v2 lower-bound artifacts. Evaluation results and raw evidence are unchanged.
Removed mutable workspace source-file paths from the artifact list; the immutable production_code patch/source manifest remains the authoritative executed-trainer provenance.

result.summary: Paired actor rewards reduced terminal variance in every production batch (mean ratio 0.558). Production ended at 263,479 legacy transition-bearing markers with at least 316,700 physical emitted paired hands; the matched curve yielded only 3/12 positive deltas and no robust cross-anchor gain.
result.conclusion: The estimator is mechanically valid and numerically stable but does not improve general learned-policy strength robustly at this scale. The isolated positive Standard10 interval at iter64 is not replicated across anchors or the learning curve.
result.next_step: Audit stochastic-training versus greedy-evaluation mode mismatch using frozen sampled-policy diagnostics before another training treatment; no Slumbot or unchanged scaling.
